protectedCommitments.statement: A traveler explores a shared physical top-down world and observes durable consequences.
A traveler enters a distinct encounter and makes meaningful command choices resolved by the Realm.
A traveler begins ordinary and identity emerges from behavior rather than mandatory class selection.
A saved traveler retains meaningful history and recoverable progress through reconnect, release and restore.
Exploration, encounter and dialogue remain original, readable and accessible at supported quality tiers.
The core loop rewards discovery, decision and consequence without coercive engagement pressure.
